chapter: Learning from players; Jonah Jones lessons
title: Jonah's thanks and the lesson fee
summary: Jonah praises Maxwell publicly and insists on paying.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: That's beautiful, that's so nice to hear.
And he told my wife once, he said there's two people in the world I respect, Jesus Christ and Jim Maxwell. And I don't know if that's the right order.

He kept coming back. And then everytime he'd be in town he'd come for some more lessons. And I didn't want to charge him. I said, how can I charge this man. I told Jonah, I owe you so much, there's so much I got from you, I can't charge you, for God's sake.
He was very --he flatly refused and I had to charge him by the hour, not by the lesson. I said, well,
I get $25.00 a lesson. He said, well, some of those lessons are three hours, you ought to get double for those. I said, no, it's just for a lesson. And needless to say, he paid me more than I wanted.
